title: Phase track
summary: The round-2 phase chart you liked, back in the page's own heading and framed panel and now full: "It starts with the audit." on one line, then each phase with what it delivers, the ten-day audit as the one red bar, a single Handover line, and your Calibrate line running out of the panel and off the page.
story: Right after the handover shows what stays if we leave, this section shows how the work starts and keeps running (the audit lit red, three build phases that run once, the handover, then the operating retainer: the one line that keeps running), and it hands "the audit" to the next section, which opens with "The audit is a gate".
motion: Entrance, standalone: the heading plays the way it does in every other section. The label fades in, "It starts with" and then "the audit." rise into place on the same line, the short red rule draws, and the intro and the note fade up. The panel rises at 0.4s. The ruler draws left to right, the ten audit ticks arrive slightly off-pitch and settle onto the scale, the column dividers draw down, and the ruler break, the phase marks under the panel appear.

The phases then build in reading order. Diagnose's column brightens and its red bar extends (from 1.3s) while the ten ticks above it light one by one. Its label, "10 working days · the System Audit", appears as the bar lands. The number is printed, not counted. The "Runs once" line draws along the bottom under the three build phases. Architect follows at 2.0s, then Install at 2.7s.

The word Handover appears on the bottom line (3.3s), and the Handover line draws up from it to the top of the panel. Calibrate's column brightens and its white bar runs out from the Handover line, through the panel edge and off the page (3.85–4.85s), together with "Keeps running". The dotted retainer line and its label fade in at 4.5s. Everything has landed by about 5.1s.

Ambient, the page's only loop besides the hero film: a small dark square rides the Calibrate bar from the Handover line off the page, one lap every 9.6 seconds, at a steady pace. It pauses while the section is off screen.

Interaction: hovering a phase lets you read it on its own. Its text and its bar stay lit (a grey build bar turns white), and the other three phases' text, bars and labels go quiet. There is nothing to click, no tabs and no toggle.

On the live page: the heading plays as the section arrives. The panel holds on its first frame until about a third of it is in view, then plays once. There is no pin and no scroll scrubbing, and scrolling back does not replay it. Reduced motion: the finished drawing appears at once, with no moving square and no timers.
addressed: "It seems a little too empty": the panel is now full from edge to edge. Each phase shows its name and what it delivers. Under the ruler sit the four bars, the audit measured as ten working days, the Handover line, the retainer line, your Calibrate line, and a bottom line that says what runs once and what keeps running. The heading is one line, so the section is about 100px shorter than before and the headline and the four phases now arrive in the same screen.

"An abrupt change in design language": it is back in the family. It uses the same heading grammar as the reframe and the stack (red-square label, two-tone headline, short red rule, intro, and a note at right), and the same framed panel and ruler. The headline runs on one line here, so it fills the width instead of leaving the top right empty, and it doesn't repeat the two-line heading of the handover directly above.
It starts from the round-2 chart you approved: four phase columns sit over the bars, each bar sits under its own phase, and the build plays left to right in reading order.

It stays clear of the clutter you disliked in round 3's system section. The handover has one label and no second marker floating above the panel. The retainer is a quiet dotted line, not a chunky bar. No numbers count up, and there is no caption strip or toggle (those stay with the reframe alone).

"Sells and deploys revenue architecture as a service" reads in one glance. The intro now says it in words: "The fourth is the operating retainer — it keeps running, because a system left alone drifts the moment the market moves." Diagnose, Architect and Install run once. The Handover line follows. Calibrate keeps running, off the edge of the page; its output says it is yours, run by your operator or with us on retainer, and a dotted line marked "With us on retainer" shows that we stay on to run it. That is the note "Install first, then an operating retainer — on a system you own", drawn. Nothing in it is about demand or reach; that is Plurel's lane.
Honest timing: the audit is the only red and the only measured span. Ten ticks sit over its bar, then the ruler breaks, so no durations are invented for the phases after it.

Your standing note on repeated layouts: the handover directly above is about ownership ("Installed by Kelwin / Owned by you", "Yours · 06 of 06"). This plate is about time, so its bottom line now reads "Runs once — Handover — Keeps running", in the intro's own words, instead of repeating "Kelwin's side … Yours". "Handover" stays as the one word that threads the two sections together.
The ‘Fig. 06 · Phase track · Indicative’ boxes under the panel are gone, as you asked — here and in every section.
notes: REVIEW PASS (adversarial, after the refiner): scored 7/10 before changes. Fixed: (1) HEAD ON ONE LINE. The two voices now share one 88px line ('It starts with' + light 'the audit.'), each still rising in its own kit mask, left to right. The two-line set left a ~500x220px void top-right (the first thing that read as 'empty'), and it repeated handover U's two-line 88px head one section up; one line keeps the family grammar (label, two-tone statement, 48x2 rule, lede, note), matches STORY's method brief (one line, two voices), cuts the stage from 1184 to 1089px, and on the homepage the statement and the four phases now share a viewport. At 760px and below it breaks back to two lines. (2) LIST SEMANTICS. 'The four phases' exposed five list items (a bare 'Handover' item). Handover is now the first paragraph inside Calibrate's item, still read between 03 and 04, still drawn on the ownership axis; on mobile it still opens card 04 as the full-width rule. (3) READING ORDER. 'Kelwin's side' was read last, after 'Yours'; it now precedes the list (positioned absolutely, so nothing moves). (4) The head note aside is named ('Engagements'), as handover U names its own. (5) The two phase gates on the indicative stretch of the ruler went from --line-2 to --fg-3, so the ruler past the break reads as marked phase starts, not a blank line (still no scale). (6) The retainer label moved from plate x 1000 to 1016, Calibrate's text edge, like every other label in the drawing (bay + 32). (7) Re-walked in page context with handover U (the promoted handover V), method U and fit S: no console errors; handover U's 'Handover' and 'Kelwin's side' labels and method's are the same token (.ac-cap, --fg-2, unboxed), so the 'if handover W wins' check below is moot. Builder notes. CHOSEN OVER W (the phase ledger + track) on the judge's call (V 40 vs W 35). V answers both halves of the note literally: it returns to method X's composition (the same head, panel, ruler and title block), so the section is no longer an abrupt change, and it fills the plate. It also stays clear of the reframe's caption band and toggle. Its ruler break, calibrated audit span and Kelwin's side → Handover → Yours axis read as a drawn plate only Kelwin would make. W read faster but looked like a generic PM-tool timeline (Asana or Linear), and its gantt half was still sparse. Its continuous day scale implied invented durations (about 12 days each for Architect and Install), and it cut Calibrate's agreed output. As a ledger it would also sit directly above fit's ledgers, and possibly beside a ledger-style handover, which is the layout repetition he keeps rejecting. MUST-FIXES, all done: (1) the 01→10 count-up is removed and '10' is static markup; the system keeps the page's one counter. (2) The title block left the gantt lanes and now sits outside the plate at its bottom-left edge, 16px below (stack X's habit). Handover V's sits outside bottom-right, so the two don't mirror beat for beat. (3) The retainer is a 1px dotted hairline (dasharray 2 4, --fg-3), 448px from x 992 to off the page in Install's lane, with its 'With us on retainer' label kept. (4) There is a single Handover callout. The T-cap and the 16px overshoot above the plate are gone, and the datum runs from the plate's top edge down to its one label on the ownership axis. (5) Token match: 'Handover' is .ac-cap, --fg-2, unboxed, knocked out of the axis on --panel. This is the same token both round-4 handover candidates use for their datum label (V and W are both .ac-cap --fg-2 with no border). 'Kelwin's side' is .ac-cap --fg-2 with a straight apostrophe, exactly as in handover V and S. If handover W wins, method's datum is a single vertical through a gantt plate, labelled at its foot. That is not W's ledger datum with a flag at its head, so it does not repeat W beat for beat; re-check once handover is chosen. (6) DECISION, do not 'fix' in the coherence pass: the title block says 'Indicative', not 'Specimen'. The drawing is the real method with indicative timing (only the audit's ten days are measured). It is not an illustrative artifact. Round 2 X and round 3 S used the same honesty label. (7) Re-shot: after the title block left, the lower-left opened slightly, so the lane band was shortened rather than filled. Lane pitch went from 36 to 32px (bar tops 280/312/344/376), the axis from 436 to 420, and the field from 476 to 456. Kelwin's lane guides now stop at the datum, so past it only Calibrate, the retainer and Yours run. The remaining open area is the gantt's own descent, anchored by the 'Kelwin's side' axis. GRAFTS FROM W: the lede sits on cols 1–7 at 60ch, so it sets in two lines. The title block is seated on the instrument's own structure. Row hover links text to bar: every bar is an opaque --panel ground with its colour on ::before, so a quieted bar never goes see-through over the lane guides. Elements the hover quiets (dim, retainer, label, Yours) enter with a 'backwards' fill, so the entrance never pins their opacity. The retainer uses W's dotted lane language. Also: the axis stub between Handover and Yours is 24px, so 'Handover ── Yours' reads as a span. The audit label sits midway between its bar and the next lane. COPY: unchanged from V and round-3 S. The ★ line 'It starts with the audit.' is verbatim as the two-voice head, and no ★ line changed. 'Engagements' + 'Install first, then an operating retainer — on a system you own.' come from FirmAbout's registry; 'Kelwin's side' from handover; 'With us on retainer' is a fragment of the agreed Calibrate output; 'Output' is Methodology.tsx's field name. No new numbers. RED: the label squares and the 48×2 rule (family), plus the Diagnose bar as the one red moment. BUDGETS: one ambient loop (the packet, 9.6s per lap, paused off screen, none under reduced motion), no counter, no pin, no door. JS: only the homepage gate (data-wait until the plate is 35% in view) and the off-screen idle. MOBILE (≤760px): one column with a bar per phase; Handover becomes a full-width rule between 03 and 04; Calibrate and Yours run off the right edge; the drawing SVG, the 'Kelwin's side' label and the retainer line + label are visibility-hidden; the title block follows the plate. No animation-name changes inside the media query. Checked at 390px: no horizontal scroll. Stage height 1089px (after the review pass); lint PASS in both skins. Page context: handover S and handover V, then method U, then fit S. No console errors. The plate holds, then builds, and the final state was verified after scrolling. Promoted from round-4 slot V. COHERENCE PASS (round 4, supersedes the token-match notes above): (1) R2 neighbour repetition with handover U: the foot axis is relabelled as a TIME axis — .kside 'Kelwin's side' → 'Runs once', .yours 'Yours' → 'Keeps running' (both the lede's own words); the 'Handover' label, datum line and node stay as the shared thread. Drawing, geometry, tokens and motion unchanged. (2) E4 applied word for word to the lede: 'The first three phases run once, in order. The fourth is the operating retainer — it keeps running, because a system left alone drifts the moment the market moves.' (no-break space before the dash so it never opens a line). It now sets in three lines at 60ch (two would exceed the 68-character measure); stage 1089 → 1119px. The Engagements note is kept as it is. (3) Title block Fig. 06 (was 05).
